advisories.title: extract-zip unvalidated symlink path traversal
advisories.reachability: Reached only through puppeteer-core 24.43.1 (pinned by lighthouse 12.6.1) when it unpacks a browser archive; exploiting it needs a malicious zip, and CI does not feed it archives other than official browser downloads.

advisories.title: tmp allows arbitrary temporary file / directory write via symbolic link `dir` parameter
advisories.reachability: Reached through the interactive editor prompt of inquirer 6 (nested tmp 0.0.33) and through tmp 0.1.0 used directly by @lhci/cli; attacker-controlled dir/prefix values are required and the CI commands pass none.

advisories.title: uuid: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf is provided
advisories.reachability: uuid 8.3.2 is used by the LHCI server component for ids; the buffer-bounds flaw needs a caller-supplied buf with v3/v5/v6 and the server is not started in client CLI audits.

advisories.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
advisories.reachability: zod 3.25.76 validates DevTools/BiDi protocol messages from the local CI browser (puppeteer-core 24.43.1 via lighthouse 12.6.1); no untrusted input.
